findings: Four M337 links are independently listed in HB207/SNL119. Four separate M339 pins follow the explicit SNL137 application: two low-speed and two track. HB207/SNL251 two-pin totals remain unresolved for the early production configuration.
Eight quarter-inch by1-1/2in split pins follow two per individual M339. The paired round-wire legs and eye joins approximate the original split section; exact stock volume is not claimed.

The centered-band link hypothesis intersected the middle diaphragm. Inboard side mounting replaces the earlier estimated support offsets and avoids a fictitious frame cutout; no transverse source section proves this hidden layout.
Lower eyes are at shaft height, 2mm clear of the middle diaphragm and 1.5mm beside the band edge. These are named design allowances, not source dimensions.

HB134/135 show the narrow web set aft of the line between eyes. Two cubic polynomial B-spline edges, degree3 with endpoint multiplicity4 and unit weights, approximate it. Poles are retained in report.json; web bow14mm is estimated, not a fitted measurement.

Original channel registration is retained in overlays. The source shaft station and modeled station still disagree; the lower eye appears forward and below the pictured anchor under this registration. Hidden section and final anchor arrangement remain conditional.
Lower anchor brackets/pins, front ears, adjusters, controls and support foot fastening are not yet installed.
